# 3D U-Net: Tumor Segmentation

This notebook trains a 3D U-Net using R `torch` on the LUMIERE dataset.

```{r libraries}
library(torch)
library(luz)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

source("R/utils.R")
source("R/01_data_loader.R")
source("R/02_preprocessing.R")
source("R/03_model_3d_unet.R")
```

## Step 1: Prepare Training Data

```{r prepare_data}
DATA_PATH <- "data/raw/LUMIERE"
PROCESSED_PATH <- "data/processed/registered"
MODEL_PATH <- "models/unet_3d.pt"

ensure_dir("models")
ensure_dir(PROCESSED_PATH)

patients <- load_patient_index(DATA_PATH)
cat("Found", nrow(patients), "patients\n")
```

## Step 2: Preprocess and Save Training Volumes

```{r preprocess, eval=FALSE}
# Run this block once to preprocess and cache all training data
# Set eval=TRUE when you have the dataset ready

TARGET_SIZE <- c(128L, 128L, 128L)

for (i in seq_len(min(nrow(patients), 20))) {
  pid <- patients$patient_id[i]
  patient_path <- patients$path[i]

  cat("Processing", pid, "(", i, "/", min(nrow(patients), 20), ")\n")

  patient_data <- tryCatch(
    load_full_patient(patient_path),
    error = function(e) { cat("  Skip:", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(patient_data)) next

  preprocess_full_patient(patient_data,
                           target_size = TARGET_SIZE,
                           output_dir = PROCESSED_PATH)
}

cat("Preprocessing complete.\n")
```

## Step 3: Collect Training Pairs

```{r collect_pairs}
mri_files <- list.files(PROCESSED_PATH, pattern = "stacked_mri\\.rds",
                         recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
seg_files <- list.files(PROCESSED_PATH, pattern = "segmentation\\.rds",
                         recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

# Match MRI to segmentation by directory
paired <- tibble(mri = mri_files) %>%
  mutate(dir = dirname(mri)) %>%
  inner_join(
    tibble(seg = seg_files) %>% mutate(dir = dirname(seg)),
    by = "dir"
  )

cat("Training pairs found:", nrow(paired), "\n")

# Train/validation split (80/20)
set.seed(42)
n <- nrow(paired)
train_idx <- sample(n, floor(n * 0.8))
val_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n), train_idx)

train_mri <- paired$mri[train_idx]
train_seg <- paired$seg[train_idx]
val_mri <- paired$mri[val_idx]
val_seg <- paired$seg[val_idx]

cat("Train:", length(train_mri), "| Val:", length(val_mri), "\n")
```

## Step 4: Train 3D U-Net

```{r train, eval=FALSE}
# Set eval=TRUE when ready to train

cat("CUDA available:", cuda_is_available(), "\n")

result <- train_unet(
  train_mri_paths = train_mri,
  train_seg_paths = train_seg,
  val_mri_paths = val_mri,
  val_seg_paths = val_seg,
  epochs = 50L,
  batch_size = 2L,
  lr = 1e-4,
  in_channels = 4L,
  n_classes = 4L,
  base_filters = 16L,
  save_path = MODEL_PATH
)

cat("Model saved to:", MODEL_PATH, "\n")
```

## Step 5: Training History

```{r plot_history, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
# After training, plot learning curves
# result$history contains train_loss and val_loss

if (exists("result")) {
  history_df <- tibble(
    epoch = seq_along(result$history$train_loss),
    train = result$history$train_loss,
    val = result$history$val_loss
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(train, val), names_to = "split", values_to = "loss")

  ggplot(history_df, aes(epoch, loss, color = split)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "3D U-Net Training History",
         x = "Epoch", y = "Loss (Dice + CE)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(train = "#2563eb", val = "#dc2626")) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

## Step 6: Evaluate Segmentation

```{r evaluate}
if (file.exists(MODEL_PATH) && length(val_mri) > 0) {
  dice_scores <- c()

  for (i in seq_along(val_mri)) {
    mri <- readRDS(val_mri[i])
    gt_seg <- readRDS(val_seg[i])

    pred_seg <- predict_segmentation(MODEL_PATH, mri)

    dice <- compute_dice(pred_seg > 0, gt_seg > 0)
    dice_scores <- c(dice_scores, dice)
  }

  cat("Validation Dice Scores:\n")
  cat("  Mean:", round(mean(dice_scores), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Std:", round(sd(dice_scores), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Min:", round(min(dice_scores), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Max:", round(max(dice_scores), 4), "\n")
}
```

## Step 7: Visualize Predictions

```{r viz_pred, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
if (file.exists(MODEL_PATH) && length(val_mri) > 0) {
  mri <- readRDS(val_mri[1])
  gt <- readRDS(val_seg[1])
  pred <- predict_segmentation(MODEL_PATH, mri)

  z <- dim(gt)[3] %/% 2

  # Pick first modality channel for display
  if (length(dim(mri)) == 4) {
    mri_slice <- mri[, , z, 1]
  } else {
    mri_slice <- mri[, , z]
  }
  gt_slice <- gt[, , z]
  pred_slice <- pred[, , z]

  df_mri <- expand.grid(x = seq_len(nrow(mri_slice)), y = seq_len(ncol(mri_slice)))
  df_mri$val <- as.vector(mri_slice)

  df_gt <- df_mri; df_gt$val <- as.vector(gt_slice)
  df_pr <- df_mri; df_pr$val <- as.vector(pred_slice)

  p1 <- ggplot(df_mri, aes(x, y, fill = val)) + geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() + coord_fixed() + labs(title = "MRI") +
    theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none")

  p2 <- ggplot(df_gt, aes(x, y, fill = factor(val))) + geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0"="black","1"="yellow","2"="green","3"="red")) +
    coord_fixed() + labs(title = "Ground Truth") +
    theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none")

  p3 <- ggplot(df_pr, aes(x, y, fill = factor(val))) + geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0"="black","1"="yellow","2"="green","3"="red")) +
    coord_fixed() + labs(title = "Prediction") +
    theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none")

  p1 + p2 + p3
}
```
